projects.title: Static Checks for Programming Exercises
bullets: Parsed small public file-processing example programs using Python and abstract syntax trees during a supervised undergraduate independent study.
Wrote checks for selected code patterns and documented false-positive cases in static checks for small programming exercises.

research.title: Small-Object Image Classification
bullets: Loaded public small-object image datasets using Python, PyTorch, and NumPy as part of supervised faculty research.
Summarized classification errors for public small-object image collections in research on small-image classification under input changes.

research.title: Natural-Scene Image Classification

Summarized classification errors for public natural-scene image collections in research on small-image classification under input changes.
